Ne Shitje | Dupleks ne Kompleksin Nobis,Liqeni i Titanes!
Në nje nga komplekset me te kerkuara te Tiranes, ofrohet per shitje nje dupleks unik me siperfaqe totale prej 360 m².
- 4 dhoma gjumi te bollshme
- 3 tualete moderne
- Verande dhe ballkone me hapesire per relaks
- Depo dhe lavanderi funksionale
- Pamje panoramike nga Liqeni i Tiranes
Ky apartament kombinon komoditetin e hapesirave te medha me luksin dhe qetesine qe ofron kompleksi. Ideale per familje qe kerkojne cilesi jetese ne nje zone elitare.
title_en: For Sale | Duplex in the "Nobis" Complex
description_en: For Sale | Duplex in Nobis Complex, Lake Titane! In one of the most sought-after complexes in Tirana, a unique duplex with a total area of ​​360 m² is offered for sale. - 4 spacious bedrooms - 3 modern bathrooms - Verandas and balconies with space for relaxation - Functional storage and laundry - Panoramic view of Tirana Lake This apartment combines the comfort of large spaces with the luxury and tranquility offered by the complex. Ideal for families looking for quality of life in an elite area.
